# 📝 [NotePad - Draft Your Paper Online](../pad/demo.html)

## 💡 About

![](../pad/NotePad.png)

NotePad is a single-page application that allows user to draft their paper with zero-distraction.

## 🌟 Feature

1. Separated fields for title, subtitle, and main content
    - You no longer need to worry about mis-editing your content

2. Extra field for ideation and references
    - You no longer need to scroll to the bottom every time when you want to dot down ideas or references.
    
3. Integration of [TinyMCE](https://www.tiny.cloud/)
    - Edit the content in a way you are familiar with.
  
4. Bulit-in translation function
    - Specially bulit for bilingual users; one-click translation between Traditional Chinese and English.
  
5. Export into multiple formats
    - You can export your draft into PDF or DOCX, depending on your need
  
## 🚥 Project Status
- ⚠ Limited Functionality - The translation proxy and API no longer function.
